text: Being here, I am struck by a sense of curiosity and anticipation. The clean, modern architecture, and the R+D wall suggest I am in a place dedicated to innovation and discovery. The mixture of technology, bright colors, and glass walls makes me feel like I am on the threshold of new knowledge. I feel the urge to explore further, to understand what ideas and experiments are unfolding in this environment. The design feels intentional, encouraging openness and transparency—qualities essential to both research and philosophy.
